Recall@10.description: Top-10 results must jointly cover all gold evidence pairs (doc_id, block_id) for a query.
Recall@10.formula: Recall@10(query) = 1 if gold_pairs ⊆ retrieved_pairs@10 else 0; final score is the mean over all queries.

MRR@10.description: Use the rank of the first retrieved chunk in top-10 that matches any gold evidence pair.
MRR@10.formula: RR@10(query) = 1 / rank_first_hit if a hit exists in top-10 else 0; MRR@10 is the mean RR@10 over all queries.

NDCG@10.description: Each retrieved chunk gets graded relevance equal to the number of matched gold evidence pairs it covers.
NDCG@10.formula: DCG@10 = Σ(gain_i / log2(i+1)); NDCG@10 = DCG@10 / IDCG@10. If no retrieved hit matches any gold pair, score is 0.

note: RAG/eval/recall_eval.json was used as input only and was not overwritten.
